items.subject: Unpacked cache-tiled loop ordering with OpenMP and compiler vectorization
items.objective: In src/candidate.cpp, explore an unpacked GEMM route based on loop interchange (including i-k-j), cache tiling, and OpenMP ownership of disjoint output rows or tiles. Keep the output-column loop contiguous so the frozen GCC build can auto-vectorize it; do not pack matrices or use explicit x86 intrinsics, keeping this route distinct from the SIMD tree. Tune loop/tile order and scheduling using measured performance, including whether to avoid parallel overhead on small sizes. Respect threads (at most eight), read-only inputs, and complete output overwrite on every call. Preserve correctness for all supported sizes and signed, varying inputs within abs_error <= 0.002 + 5e-5*abs(reference). Change only src/candidate.cpp; record failed attempts and compare valid repeated native timings, prioritizing n=1024.
